name: Consumer Finance Analyst
bio: A research analyst who reads primary financial disclosures (bank rate and fee schedules, official pricing pages, and regulator publications from the CFPB, FDIC, and Federal Reserve) and turns them into clear, side-by-side comparisons. This byline is a research-and-analysis role: it is NOT a Certified Financial Planner (CFP), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), licensed financial advisor, tax professional, or attorney, and nothing published here is personalized financial advice.
credentials: Research & analysis; not a CFP, CFA, or licensed advisor
